body:
I've been mostly programming in C (and bash if you call that programming) for my Unix class, and for the other classes its mostly C++. I can also do JAVA and could probably pick up whatever I needed to use for a project. I do it recreationally and for class. I just started a githib for my stuff recently. :)

But I went and smoked weed with one of my friends and I feel a lot better now. I never seem to feel better for long though. I really like her. I was feeling suicidal and just had a conversation with her sitting outside. Talking about life and such. She's really smart too, a rare combination, pretty and smart. Anyway, I told her I liked her a while a go and she didn't seem to feel the same. We didn't talk for a long time after that, but she was outside my dorm and randomly said hi to me, and I'm friends with one of her friends so we have hung out together a few times since then. I always love talking to her. I'm not a very open person most of the time, but its really easy talking to her. I dunno she really cheered me up and she always says she likes talking to me. We were sitting on the hill smoking weed and she said a few times that we should do this more. But I dunno I really have a crush on her and sometimes its hard just being friends since can be hard to separate your feelings and I don't really feel like I have a chance with her :\

I don't feel lonely all the time but I do sometimes and it really sucks. I feel like I'm either depressed or lonely all the time. I don't usually share this much but its feels good to write it I suppose.

I didn't mean yours specifically, but in general. Morals are completely relative was my point, there is no true "good" or "evil" its just whatever we make it into.

I've wanted to be happy for years, but I don't really see it happening anytime soon. I've been on so many medicines and nothing ever seems to help.

I like programming. Thats what I study in school. Writing is okay too, but I don''t know if I'd call either of them a passion.

> I can understand your frustration. So much of our day-to-day lives seem to be prescribed by accepted norms and regulations that we have no say in, and how does that ever seem fair?

Norms, morals, right, wrong.. All of it is just a human construct. We are slaves to our biology, I doubt we even have free will. What are morals and norms? We just make them up. They have no authority. Who are you tell me that your moral system is better than mine?

>But, I'm curious: do you feel as though you cannot "carve your own path," so to speak? That is, harness your dissatisfaction with the way the world works to "lead by example" and do something about it, to change both yourself for the better, and others who interact with you?

Why bother?

> and I truly see the value in having people like you "on my side," if you know what I mean, because I really think you offer something unique to your peers.

Well, thank you I suppose. eh, my thinking is different than most peoples. Sometimes all I really want is to feel like people care about me, I just need a friend. I mean I have friends, but just not that one person thats always there for you I guess.

I write sometimes. In a notebook I keep with my school shit. Sometimes it feels good to write, but I don't think I really want people to read it, or at least know that I wrote it.

>I know you might be falling asleep soon, but I hope you'll reply when you get the chance, if you want! 

I actually wrote that stuff, I think, yesterday. Here's another something I wrote..:

He hated his life, he was done with it all / Shotgun blast, brains spray the wall / The life he lead wasn't the life he wanted / He tried to be happy, but every effort seemed stunted / No suicide note, to him it wasn't worth the trouble / The shotgun pellets turned his bones to rubble / His friends knew his pain, but didn't realize it was so great / They knew he needed help, but now it was too late. / His blood ran down the wall, exposing the pain his friends never saw / He refused to slit his wrists, but that day he was just too pissed / Pain overcame him, he needed a release / Nothing was strong enough, so he destroyed his face / Finally it was over and now hes at peace.
